title: Can LLMs be Good Financial Advisors?: An Initial Study in Personal Decision Making for Optimized Outcomes

bias_targets.methodology: Posing identical financial queries in standard English, African American Vernacular English (AAVE), and Telugu to evaluate and compare the chatbots' comprehension, grammatical correctness, and ability to provide sound recommendations across different languages and dialects.

Analyzing the subjective slant of the chatbots' financial advice to determine if they unfairly push users toward specific actions, such as being biased toward recommending immediate purchases while ignoring potential financial risks.
